latestVona.title: Semeru - 20260913/1515Z
latestVona.text: Eruption with volcanic ash cloud at 1515 UTC (2215 local). Best estimate of ash-cloud top is around 13363 FT (4176 M) above sea level or 1600 FT (500 M) above summit. May be higher than what can be observed clearly. Source of height data: ground observer. Ash cloud moving to north. Volcanic ash is observed to be white to gray. The intensity of volcanic ash is observed to be thick..
